directly_entailed: CBC implementations must eliminate the opportunity for a padding-oracle attack.
Adding a MAC over ciphertext is required to prevent creation of valid attacker-controlled ciphertext.
not_directly_entailed: Every padding failure must return one generic negative integer.
The existence of a named padding-error constant is itself a vulnerability.
A logging or return statement proves that an attacker can externally distinguish outcomes by value, message, timing, or state.
required_program_facts: authenticated preprocessing and complete service boundary
attacker-observable output, status, timing, and state-transition channels
equivalence or distinguishability of malformed-padding and other failure paths
MAC or authenticated-encryption protection and verify-before-release ordering
interprocedural control flow and all return paths
